detail.longDescription: Last week, a lot of people reported that Opus 5.5 was nerfed [1], right before the release of Fable 5.2. Unfortunately, benchmarks like livenerf [2] didn’t detect it. Now it seems to be back to normal, at least in my experience. Can anyone else confirm? [1] https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=50422069 [2] https://github.com/ninjahawk/livenerf
